method: 2 fps frame review of the tone-mapped master (259 frames)

beats.visible: At the foot of a wide concrete staircase drenched in deep blue light, looking up. Coffered skylight ceiling, small LED dots along the stair edge.
Climbing; the top landing glows; silhouettes appear at the top of the stairs.
Two guests start coming down the stairs toward us.
Guests pass on the stairs; a man in a black tee walks down on the left.
Nearing the top: a red exit light on the left, a glowing cyan sign and pale screens ahead.
Top of the stairs: a man walks past; a cyan glowing sign stands on the floor.
A wide dark-blue hall opens out: the glowing cyan sign on the left, windows and small screens at the far end.
Guests silhouetted against the far windows walk toward us; a small green-cyan screen glows on the right.
A woman in black passes close; the glowing cyan sign stands like a beacon on the floor.
Walking past the cyan light sign on the left; a long wall of windows with the city at night.
The sign slides out of frame left; tall-table guests by the windows.
A dim blue lounge: guests at tall tables in white cloths along the windows.
Very dark blue; people at tables; small glowing screens near the windows.
Turning through the room; low seating and glowing screens across the floor.
Deep blue, low light: a long dark bench and lounge seating, screens glowing at the far wall.
Walking along the room toward a doorway with a red exit sign.
A doorway beneath an exit sign and a cluster of spotlights; a man in a white shirt walks through.
Following him into a long, narrow white corridor glowing blue, with a light rail along the ceiling.
The corridor stretches far; pink and white lights flicker at the far end; doors along the walls.
The man steps into a doorway on the right; the corridor continues.
Alone in the long blue corridor; a red EXIT sign ahead on the left.
Passing under the EXIT sign; silhouettes stand at the far end of the corridor.
Approaching the end: a group silhouetted in a doorway, blue light pooling on the floor.
Closer to the end: confetti-coloured party lights (red, green, pink) start to dance on the walls.
A disco-lit doorway: guests in striped shirts, coloured light specks scatter across floor and ceiling.
Through the doorway into a bigger party floor alive with moving coloured dots.
A large blue room full of guests; pillars; the window wall glows with small screens.
A man in a leather jacket stands by a pillar; white curtains at the far end lit warm.
Wide room: guests along the windows, warm stage-like light at the curtains.
Small portrait screens glow cyan along the window wall, showing white line-art graphics.
Moving lights sweep pink, red and green across the ceiling; dancers and guests ahead.
Party lights on tripods; a guest walks toward us; the ceiling flashes green.
The ceiling fills with pink and green light specks; the room brightens to violet.
A brighter violet gallery: guests chatting in pairs, spotlights on tracks.
A crowded violet hall: guests in NOUSCON jackets queue along the wall.
Groups stand in silhouette against bright violet galleries beyond.
Guests with tote bags walk ahead; tall white columns, track spotlights.
A man in a denim shirt looks at his phone; a bright white-and-violet balcony beyond.
A quieter corner: glass door, a big potted plant, an exit sign.
A white room with a long planter of leafy tropical plants.
Plants on the left, a white balcony wall on the right; two guests lean on the rail.
Passing the planter; a red exit sign above a window to the night city.
An empty white corner room washed in violet; warm floor spots.
Turning right into a narrow white passage; a man in black stands against the wall.
A long white hall with glass panels and doors; violet light; guests far down the hall.
The hall opens onto a balcony where guests line a glass rail.
Back in deep blue: guests standing along the rail, glowing portrait screens behind them.
Blue lounge: glowing white line-art screens along the windows; a guest steps past.
A glowing white poster-like screen of line art at the windows grows larger.
Turning toward a glass balustrade: a bright atrium opens up below.
Looking down over the glass rail into the bright atrium: black leather cubes and guests far below.
Final view: the atrium seen from the balcony, the evening in full swing below.

chapters.title: The Blue Ascent
chapters.blurb: A concrete staircase drowned in deep blue, guests drifting down past you.

chapters.blurb: Tall tables, low seating and glowing screens in the dark.

chapters.title: The Long Corridor
chapters.blurb: A narrow white corridor glowing blue, party lights waiting at the end.

chapters.title: Disco Floor
chapters.blurb: Confetti light, a packed floor, cyan line-art screens on the windows.

chapters.title: Violet Gallery
chapters.blurb: A bright violet hall full of NOUSCON jackets and conversation.

chapters.title: The Plant Room
chapters.blurb: A quiet white corner with tropical planters and night windows.

chapters.title: The Balcony
chapters.blurb: Glowing screens along the rail and the atrium far below.
